privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: How we protect your data
privacyPolicy.body:
Brújula collects the information you provide (profile details, resume, work experience) to connect job seekers with employers on this platform. We do not sell your data to third parties. Your contact information is only shared with employers you apply to. You can request deletion of your account and data at any time from this screen.

This is placeholder text for the MVP and has not been reviewed by legal counsel — replace it with a real privacy policy before a public launch.

about.title: About Brújula
about.mission: Brújula connects Cuban talent with real opportunity — structured applications instead of a post that disappears in a WhatsApp group, verified employers instead of anonymous listings.

clearDirection.title: Clear direction
clearDirection.body: Real application status — pending, reviewed, accepted — not a post lost in a group chat.

verifiedTrust.title: Verified trust
verifiedTrust.body: Real company profiles, verified emails. You know who's posting, not just what's posted.

builtForCuba.title: Built for Cuba
builtForCuba.body: CUP, MLC, and USD live side by side. Subscription pricing built for what things actually cost here, not imported from Silicon Valley.

openDoors.title: Open doors
openDoors.body: Local and remote work in the same place — you shouldn't have to choose between staying or leaving to find opportunity.
